test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following will verify the credentials and documents of applicants uploaded on the National Scholarship Portal?

options.text: The University/Institute in which the applicant is studying.

solution:
The University/Institute in which the applicant is studying. 

__**Concept:**__

On the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), applicants upload their academic, personal, and bank-related documents. These documents must be authenticated to ensure that only eligible and genuine students receive scholarship benefits.

The first level of verification is done by the **Institute/University** where the student is currently enrolled. They verify:

__
 
• Student’s enrollment status
 
• Academic records
 
• Documents uploaded by the student
 
• Course and fee details

This institute-level verification is mandatory before the application can move to district/state verification.

**Explanation:**__

**National Scholarship Portal:** It only provides the platform; it does not verify documents.

**Third Party:** External agencies are not involved in document verification.

**Government:** Final approval is done by authorities, but initial document verification is handled by the student's institution.

__**Answer:**__

**The University/Institute in which the applicant is studying.**
